user.title: Select İETT Tracking Mode
user.description:
Choose a tracking profile to add. City-wide Traffic Index (Overall, Europe, Anatolia) and Active Fleet Size (bus count only) sensors are created automatically on first setup.

Tip: If you only want a live stop/route board on your Dashboard without creating background polling sensors, you can add the `custom:iett-card` Lovelace card directly after setup.

menu_options.root: Istanbul City-Wide Root Sensors (3 Traffic + 1 Fleet Size)
menu_options.stop: a) Add Stop (Enter/search stop code or name)
menu_options.route: b) Add Route (Enter/search route code or name)
menu_options.vehicle: c) Add Single Bus (Door No: strict X-NNNN format)

stop.title: Search Stop
stop.description: Enter the 6-digit stop code (e.g. 220602) or search by stop name (e.g. Besiktas Meydan, Ahmet Mithat Efendi).

data_description.stop_query: If you know the 6-digit stop code, enter it directly. If you enter a name, the next step will list matching stops along with their travel direction (➔ Direction • District).

stop_select.title: Select Stop & Direction
stop_select.description: Stops on opposite sides of the street share the same name but have different codes and travel directions. Check the direction in parentheses (➔ Direction • District) to pick the right side:

data_description.selected_stop: The arrow (➔) indicates which direction buses passing through this stop are heading toward.

stop_config.title: Stop Attributes & Filters
stop_config.description: Configure tracking filters and Home Assistant entities for **{stop_name}** (`{stop_code}` • Direction: **{stop_direction}**).

data.custom_lat: Home / Reference Latitude (Auto-filled from HA Home Zone)
data.custom_lon: Home / Reference Longitude (Auto-filled from HA Home Zone)

data_description.route_mode: Choose 'All Routes' to track every bus approaching this stop, or 'Selected Routes' to filter only specific bus lines below.
data_description.selected_routes: Used only when Route Filter Mode is set to 'Selected Routes'. Pick one or more lines passing through this stop (ignored in 'All Routes' mode).
data_description.vehicle_limit_mode: 'Nearest N Vehicles' creates dedicated sensors for each approaching bus slot (Araç 1..N). 'All Approaching Vehicles' stores the full array inside the general stop sensor's attributes and only creates slot sensors for the 1st closest bus.
data_description.vehicle_limit_n: How many upcoming buses to create individual sensor sets for (1 to 10). Only applies when 'Nearest N Vehicles' is selected above.
data_description.stop_attributes: Select which data points to expose as sensors/attributes. Selecting 'Create GPS Device Tracker' will also place the approaching bus live on your Home Assistant Map.
data_description.speed_unit: Unit of measurement for bus speed sensors and attributes (km/h or mph).
data_description.custom_lat: Automatically pre-filled from your Home Assistant Home Zone (Settings -> System -> General). Used only when 'Distance to Target/Home (meters)' is selected above to calculate straight-line distance from the bus to your home/target.
data_description.custom_lon: Automatically pre-filled from your Home Assistant Home Zone longitude. You can keep it as your home or change it to any reference point.
data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) Home Assistant polls İETT for live arrivals at this stop (Recommended: 30s).

route.title: Search Route
route.description: Enter the route code (e.g. 500T, 14M) or route name.

data_description.route_query: Enter an exact route code (e.g. 14M) or search by neighborhood/terminal name (e.g. Kavacik).

route_select.title: Select Route
route_select.description: Select a route from the search results:

route_config.title: Route Options & Departures
route_config.description: Configure active bus count, scheduled departures, and disruption alerts for route **{route_code}**.

data_description.include_active_buses: Creates a sensor showing how many buses are currently operating on this route (with Outbound/Inbound counts and bus list).
data_description.include_announcements: Creates a sensor and problem alert binary_sensor for official İETT route delays, detours, and service notices.
data_description.include_schedule: Creates countdown sensor(s) showing minutes until the next scheduled timetable departure (filtered by Istanbul local time and weekday/weekend schedule).
data_description.direction_filter: Choose whether to create next departure sensors for Outbound (G), Inbound (D), or Both directions.
data_description.depar_mode: Some routes have short-turn or branch variants (D1, D2, etc.). Choose 'Exclude Depars (Main Route D0)' to only track full main-line departures.
data_description.selected_depars: Used only if 'Selected Depars Only' is chosen above.
data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) route data is refreshed (Recommended: 30s).

vehicle.title: Single Bus Tracking (Strict Door No)
vehicle.description: Enter the bus door number in hyphenated **X-NNNN** format (e.g. `C-1753`, `A-001`, `M-1042`). License plates are not accepted because plate-to-fleet mapping can change.

data_description.kapino: Must be 1-2 letters, a hyphen (-), and 3-5 digits (e.g. C-1753). Creates Plate, Speed, Active Route, Coordinates, and live Map Tracker (device_tracker) entities.
data_description.speed_unit: Unit of measurement for the vehicle speed sensor (km/h or mph).
data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) vehicle position is polled (Recommended: 30s).
